subject: Request: KMS operator interview + rotation log handoff / schedule
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@bluehorizon.io>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-28T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: KMS operator interview + rotation log handoff

Hi Marissa,

Hope you9re well. Blue Horizon is kicking off a SIG questionnaire and our auditor (Clearsight) has a quick set of follow-ups related to KMS/HSM operations and recent key rotation activity. We9d like to: 
- schedule a short (30m) operator interview with whoever runs the key ceremonies/rotation
- obtain rotation logs for the last 6 months (audit-trace, operator IDs, actions, timestamps)
- confirm transport method for delivering logs and the preferred transfer process (SFTP vs presigned S3 with restricted IP)
- get a brief HSM attestation summary (vendor, model, firmware, and any tamper/SEAL notes)

Can you confirm availability this week or next and the expected artifacts you can deliver? Auditor timeline is tight: they want an intake package by Aug 6. If you prefer, we can accept redacted operator IDs and checksummed CSV exports.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Senior Security Engineer | Blue Horizon
Dan.Phone: +1 415-555-0123

P.S. Attaching our intake checklist (we will upload our SIG follow-ups once we have the intake).
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@bluehorizon.io>
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-28T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: KMS operator interview + rotation log handoff

Daniel,

Thanks for the note and the timeline heads-up. We can support the intake by Aug 6 with the following plan:

1) Operator interview: 30 minutes. Proposed slots (PDT): Mon 7/29 14:00-14:30, Tue 7/30 10:30-11:00, Wed 7/31 09:00-09:30. Interview will include: an ops lead (Irene) and the crypto engineer (Jonas).

2) Artifacts we can produce by Aug 6 (redacted where appropriate):
   - rotation_log_manifest.csv (CSV with event_time, action, key_id_hash, operator_role, operation_result)
   - operator_matrix_redacted.pdf (role-based access matrix with operator IDs pseudonymized)
   - hsm_attestation_summary.pdf (vendor/model/firmware + short statement of tamper monitoring; no vendor-signed certs in the package unless requested)

3) Transfer: we recommend a time-limited presigned S3 bundle (HTTPS, TLS 1.3) with IP restriction + one-time password; if your auditor requires SFTP we can provision an AWS Transfer Family endpoint and provide PGP-encrypted archives. We will include SHA256 checksums and a signed manifest.

4) Sampling: to minimize PII risk we can supply a full manifest plus a sampled log export (every Nth rotation event and all associated metadata) and an auditable checksum chain. If Clearsight needs full operator IDs for signature verification we will discuss a controlled disclosure workflow.

Next steps: confirm which interview slot works, and whether you prefer presigned S3 or SFTP/PGP. Once confirmed, Irene will draft the manifest and Jonas will extract the sampling subset for review.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0234

Attachments: rotation_log_manifest.csv (stub), operator_matrix_redacted.pdf (stub)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@bluehorizon.io>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-07-29T08:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: KMS operator interview + rotation log handoff

On Jul 28, 2027, Marissa Cole wrote:
> Daniel,
>
> Thanks for the note and the timeline heads-up...

Daniel,

I can take the operator interview and provide the log extracts. A couple of operational clarifications up front: 
- Rotation cadence: master wrapping keys rotate quarterly; tenant KEKs rotate on-demand with documented change requests.
- Log retention: rotation events stored in our audit lake for 18 months; we will export the 6-month window you requested.
- Redaction: operator IDs will be pseudonymized as OP-{hash4} unless Clearsight requires real identities under NDA.
- Transport mechanics: for presigned S3 we will generate one bucket with a time-limited prefix and provide a signed manifest (SHA256) and a detached PGP signature of the manifest.

I will prepare a short sample (10 events) in CSV so you can confirm format before we deliver the full export.

Proposed interview: Tue 7/30 10:30-11:00 PDT. Please confirm and I9ll send the calendar invite and a short questionnaire so our engineers can prepare.

Irene Choi
Sr. Manager, Crypto Ops | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Attachments: transfer_instructions.txt (stub, includes S3 presign and IP rules)
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@bluehorizon.io>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-04T15:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: KMS operator interview + rotation log handoff

Thanks, Marissa and Irene. Tue 7/30 10:30 works for the interview — I9ll join along with our auditor rep (Clearsight). Two quick clarifications before the intake: 

1) HSM attestation: can you include a one-page vendor/firmware summary (we do need vendor model, firmware build, and whether FIPS 140-2/3 module self-test logs are available). A vendor-signed attestation is optional but appreciated.

2) Transport: presigned S3 with IP restriction + SHA256 manifest is acceptable. Please include the transfer checklist (PGP public key we should use to sign receipts).

3) Delivery format: CSV is fine. Please ensure the rotation_log_manifest.csv contains a stable event UUID column so our auditors can verify event continuity.

If you can send the sample (10 events) and the brief HSM summary before the interview, that would speed things up. We9ll formalize the intake package after the call and confirm if any additional items are required for the SIG follow-up.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Regards,
Daniel Park
Senior Security Engineer | Blue Horizon

Attachments: (none)
